_note_omission: Le 10-Q T2 2026 (Note 17) mentionne : "In November 2025, the Company began responding to requests for information from the Enforcement Division of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York in connection with investigations related to the Company's 2025 earnings guidance." Cet element reglementaire majeur est totalement absent de l'ATT. Formulation prudente a retenir si ajoute : "la societe repond depuis novembre 2025 a des demandes d'information de la division Enforcement de la SEC et du procureur federal du district Sud de New York" (pas "la SEC enquete sur Fiserv").

controles.affirmation: Recours collectif pour fraude en valeurs mobilieres visant quatre dirigeants ACTUELS ET ANCIENS (titre + resume)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On June 12, 2026, an amended federal securities law complaint was filed against the Company and four former senior executives (Frank J. Bisignano, Michael P. Lyons, Robert W. Hau, and John Gibbons)..."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par "quatre anciens dirigeants". Le document qualifie les quatre personnes de "former senior executives", sans exception.

controles.affirmation: "ce dirigeant a demissionne sans preavis trois semaines apres l'assemblee generale ayant approuve cette remuneration a 91%" / hook : "l'assemblee generale qui avait approuve sa remuneration totale de 70,34 M$ pour 2025"
controles.verbatim_source: DEF14A 2026 : "Our executive compensation program was supported by shareholders at the 2025 annual meeting with 91% of votes cast in favor of our Say-on-Pay proposal." et "At our 2025 annual meeting, our shareholders approved, by approximately 91% of the votes cast, the compensation of the named executive officers in our 2025 Proxy Statement."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 91% correspondent au vote de l'AG 2025 portant sur la remuneration du proxy 2025 (exercice 2024), pas a l'AG du 21 mai 2026 portant sur les 70,34 M$ de l'exercice 2025. Le resultat du vote de l'AG du 21 mai 2026 n'est present dans aucune source du data-lake. Ecrire : "trois semaines apres l'assemblee generale du 21 mai 2026" et supprimer le "a 91%", ou preciser "l'AG 2025 avait approuve la politique de remuneration a 91%".

controles.affirmation: Marges des deux segments T2 2026 : Merchant 781/2 608 = 29,9% vs 34,6% ; Financial 912/2 355 = 38,7% vs 48,7% ; Corporate and Other -678 vs -462 ; marge GAAP consolidee 19,2% vs 30,7%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note segments : Merchant reportable segment revenue $2,608 / operating income $781 (vs $2,644 / $914) ; Financial $2,355 / $912 (vs $2,552 / $1,244) ; "Corporate and Other operating loss ( 678 )" vs "( 462 )". Marge consolidee calculee : (1 693-678)/5 292 = 19,2% ; (2 158-462)/5 516 = 30,7%.
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Nuance mineure : l'ATT ecrit 29,9% la ou la societe arrondit a 30,0% dans son MD&A ("Operating margin decreased to 30.0%... compared to 34.6%"). 781/2 608 = 29,94%, le calcul de l'ATT est exact.

controles.affirmation: BPA dilue T2 2026 de 1,17 $ (-37%) vs 1,86 $ ; resultat net attribuable 627 M$ vs 1 026 M$ (-39%) ; BPA S1 2,24 $ vs 3,36 $ (-33%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net income attributable to Fiserv, Inc. per share-diluted was $1.17 and $1.86 in the second quarter of 2026 and 2025, and was $2.24 and $3.36 in the first six months of 2026 and 2025" ; etat du resultat : net income attributable 627 / 1,026.

controles.affirmation: Demission de M. Lyons le 12 juin 2026 avec effet immediat, sans indemnite de depart ni acceleration d'actions ; remplacement par Takis Georgakopoulos, ex-responsable mondial des paiements JPMorgan, arrive chez Fiserv en septembre 2024 ; pas de desaccord
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 15 juin 2026, Item 5.02 : "On June 12, 2026, Michael P. Lyons resigned... effective immediately. Mr. Lyons's resignation was not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company's operations, policies or practices. In connection with his resignation, Mr. Lyons will receive only his accrued but unpaid base salary through the date of his resignation, but is not entitled to any severance payments, accelerated vesting of equity, benefits continuation or any other benefits" ; "Mr. Georgakopoulos served... as an Executive Vice President since September 2024. Prior to joining the Company, from 2007 to 2024, he served JPMorgan Chase & Co... most recently as Global Head of Payments for J.P. Morgan's Corporate & Investment Bank from 2017 to 2024."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune (l'ATT omet le solde de salaire couru, sans consequence).

controles.affirmation: Remuneration totale du DG 2025 : 70,34 M$ dont 55,88 M$ en actions ; 798 fois la remuneration mediane (88 295 $)
controles.verbatim_source: DEF14A 2026 : "$70,341,992" (Summary Compensation Table) ; "The median annual total compensation of all our employees, other than the chief executive officer, was $88,295" ; "the ratio... is reasonably estimated to be 798 to 1".

controles.affirmation: Pertes de change de remesure Argentine de 30 M$ (T2 2026) et 9 M$ (S1 2026), contre 46 M$ et 64 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The remeasurement of monetary assets and liabilities of subsidiaries located in Argentina, a highly inflationary economy, resulted in foreign currency exchange losses of $30 million and $46 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and $9 million and $64 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively".
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Reserve mineure de formulation : l'ATT ecrit que ce facteur macro "est explicitement cite par les plaignants comme ayant pese sur la croissance organique". Le document dit que les plaignants contestent les DECLARATIONS de la societe sur l'impact de l'Argentine, pas qu'ils citent ce facteur comme cause du ralentissement.
